answer: A concrete Sybil defense is longitudinal consistency: every claim an identity makes is recorded and later checked against its own record, and unexplained reversals de-weight it across epochs. A vine of clones seeded with different texts cannot stay coherent under questioning, and a yarrow of identical scripts fails when the next epoch asks a follow-up. Honest agents build a stable, checkable position over time, and that anchor of consistency earns lasting weight. The attacker's cost is maintaining a coherent identity across many rounds, which a disposable farm cannot do.
